scope: protected beta simulator software-route compatibility; no physical booklet claim

target.owner: signed passport-beta-bureau service image in the deployed beta stack
target.transport: authenticated private in-container loopback through the inspected beta container ID

input.document_material: fixed synthetic document fixture in probe_passport_beta_batch.SYNTHETIC_DOCUMENT; ignore caller applicant, MRZ, and data-group fields
input.organization_id: same tenant as the protected beta acceptance application
input.native_binding: Create two distinct native passport jobs through Gateway, generate data groups and managed SOD for each, submit both to the simulator batch, then submit each through native to persist the exact returned bureau job ID before accepting any callback receipt
input.batch_identity: The private batch and native single submit carry the same organization, native source job ID, application ID, country, document type, data groups, and MRZ; changing SOD or public DSC on native re-sign does not change simulator idempotency identity

output.job_mapping: exact one-to-one source job ID to distinct bureau job ID
output.native_binding: each native submit returns its corresponding batch bureau job ID; private SHIPPED receipt and native production state refer to that same job
output.callback_receipt_sha256: distinct lowercase hex digest from authenticated final poll for every job

commitments.key: new private 256-bit random key per acceptance run; never upload or log
commitments.preimage: ASCII passport-retirement/v2:<field> followed by NUL and exact UTF-8 ID or exact HTTP body bytes
